messages.subject: Failed to factorize Q. I will try to fix it..._740, Thread_ 2
parts:
Dear INLA group,

When I try to run inla model, my formula is :

rprior <- list(rho = list(prior = 'pc.cor1', param = c(0, 0.9)))

formula <- y ~ 0 + X1 + X2 + X3 + f(w, model = spde.sp_2012_2016, group = w.group, control.group = list(model = "ar1", hyper = rprior))

restime <- inla(formula,
                family = "binomial", Ntrials = numtrials,
                control.family = list(link = "logit"),
                data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
                control.predictor = list(
                  compute = TRUE, link = 1,
                  A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)),
                control.compute=list(cpo = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, config = TRUE),
                control.inla = list(cmin = 0, int.strategy="eb", strategy="adaptive"),
                num.threads="4:1",
                verbose = TRUE)

I happen to meet these errors: 
Function: GMRFLib_factorise_sparse_matrix_TAUCS(), Line: 740, Thread: 2 Failed to factorize Q. I will try to fix it...

Could you please give me any advice?
Thank you!
Best!

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Failed to factorize Q. I will try to fix it..._740, Thread_ 2
parts:
its a warning, not an error. if these msg's are only in the beginning,
then its ok, if they never stop, then you have a problem

this example illustrate a problem with the model, as you see the prior
is improper and there are no data.

inla(y ~ 1, data=data.frame(y=NA), control.fixed=list(prec.intercept=0),
verbose=T)
